div.div:
Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Accept-original includes
the mobile direct upload responsibility. Publish-result includes Content-owned acceptance. Presigning, retries, attempt fencing and outbox delivery remain in sequences 27–31.
